about: EXPATs in BERLIN, the standup comedy show where stories from different cultures and parts of the world meet! Are you an expat in Berlin? Still trying to make sense of Berlin? Don't worry, it doesn't and neither can we make sense of it! So, come down and join a bunch of fellow failed integration experiments who will share their hilarious stories of (not) adapting to life in Berlin. This is a fun new English Comedy Show with Patrick Moore about the different experiences of people from abroad living in Berlin. This is a show with experienced comics and newcomers alike.
